title: Adult Nursing
subject: Nursing & Health
summary: Train to become a registered adult nurse, combining university study with hospital and community placements.
description: This degree prepares you to care for adults with a wide range of health needs, from acute hospital care to supporting people at home.
Around half of your time is spent on clinical placements. When you graduate you can apply to join the Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC) register.
entryRequirements: A-levels, BTEC or an Access to Higher Education Diploma (Level 3), usually including a science or health subject
GCSE English and Maths at grade 4/C or above
Enhanced DBS check and occupational health clearance
